conversion: Original checkpoint graph, positions, prefab trigger bounds and horizontal spawn/heading preserved; vertical Kestrel clearance is recorded separately. Empty builtin mesh bounds are recovered from the exported source geometry. Source Start is folded into Finish once per lap; our countdown begins at spawn. Gate normal sign follows the ordered route. Authored track props must be imported before activation.
trackProps: Original visible prefab geometry, PBR materials and blueprint transforms. Non-trigger collision retained; source repair/charge logic is not implemented. Checkpoint trigger renderers remain hidden.

spawnClearance.rule: Height-only clearance for the Kestrel compound collision and a 0.18 metre centre probe; source X/Z and yaw retained. Search step 0.01 m, maximum 0.5 m.
